extraction.reason: The essay makes a historical, qualitative argument: knowledge-based methods help in the short term and then plateau, while methods that scale computation through search and learning eventually win. It gives no equations, rates, functional forms, worked examples or numbers for either curve. Its only quantitative premise, 'continued exponentially falling cost per unit of computation', comes with no rate or performance model. Any simulation or diagram would need performance-versus-compute curves, a crossover point or a doubling time that the document never states, and inventing those would fabricate the very result being shown. No sub-result or computable configuration in the text supports an honest figure.
